A city skyline at night: a deep navy sky with a big pale yellow crescent moon; a row of chunky dark indigo skyscrapers, each with a few big glowing teal and rose-pink windows; their reflections on a calm dark river in front.

Style: a bold, simple illustration that will be displayed TINY as a framed picture on an office wall in a pixel art game (smaller than 64 pixels wide). Use large flat areas of strong saturated color, high contrast between neighbouring shapes, chunky iconic shapes and very few details; no thin lines, no small text. The artwork must fill the ENTIRE wide canvas edge to edge (full bleed), with no white or empty margins and no letterboxing: no frame, no border, no wall, no mat, no signature, no letters.

A pixel art scene of a calm, empty modern office interior late at night, in top-down 3/4 view like a cozy management game. Pale lavender-grey floor tiles with subtle grout lines; a lounge corner with a deep teal sofa, rose-pink cushions and a navy rug; two islands of white desks with glowing teal monitors, keyboards and mugs, grey office chairs pushed in, and warm amber desk lamps casting golden pools of light; potted plants in dark pots; tall walnut shelves with colorful binders; a water cooler with a blue jug; a small coffee counter. Big windows along the back wall show a deep navy night sky with a few stars and distant dark city silhouettes with small lit windows. A thin teal neon strip runs along the top of the back wall. Calm, quiet, inviting atmosphere, nobody there: no people, no characters, no animals.

Style: authentic pixel art made of crisp hard-edged square pixels on a perfectly regular grid, limited palette, flat color fills with 3-4 shades per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise, no dithering. Calm late-night neon-lit studio pixel art with its own original look: deep navy (#1d2240) and indigo (#3a3f7a) shadows, glowing teal (#35d0c8) monitor screens and neon light strips, a few pink-rose (#e0559a) accents, warm amber desk lamps (#f2b552), pale lavender-grey walls (#e6e8f4), dark walnut wood, bluish glass, potted plants with lush green leaves. Original artwork: do not copy or imitate any existing game, tileset or artist. Outlines in dark blue-grey (#2b3245), never pure black. Light comes from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
